name: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme (Jammu and Kashmir)
benefit:
**Amount of Pension:** The beneficiary will receive a monthly pension of ₹1000/-.
**Mode of Disbursement:** The pension is disbursed to the beneficiary either through bank transfer or money order.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should be a resident of the Union Territory of Jammu and Kashmir. 1. The applicant should be a person with a disability. 1. The applicant's age should be between 18 and over 80 years. 1. The applicant should belong to a Below Poverty Line (BPL) family. 1. The applicant should not be receiving pension benefits under any other social security scheme.
